verdict.rationale: Godot ships a built-in GDScript language server (LSP) that external editors/agent tooling can attach to, with the official godotengine/godot-vscode-plugin serving as a first-party LSP client, plus documented support for external editors (VS Code, Sublime) and .NET tooling for C#. missing for 10: direct first-party docs page detailing LSP protocol/diagnostics/navigation features, and independent hands-on confirmation of an AI coding agent successfully attaching to it.
